```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(jsonlite)

df <- read_rds("data/processed/nhanes_sleep_strength.rds")

# Prepare Lifespan x Sleep surface matrices (All, Male, Female)
df_binned <- df |>
  mutate(
    age_band = cut(
      age,
      breaks = c(15, 24, 34, 44, 54, 64, 74, 85),
      labels = c("16–24", "25–34", "35–44", "45–54", "55–64", "65–74", "75–80+")
    ),
    sleep_bin = case_when(
      sleep_hours <= 4 ~ "≤4h",
      sleep_hours == 5 ~ "5h",
      sleep_hours == 6 ~ "6h",
      sleep_hours == 7 ~ "7h",
      sleep_hours == 8 ~ "8h",
      sleep_hours == 9 ~ "9h",
      sleep_hours >= 10 ~ "10+h"
    ) |> factor(levels = c("≤4h", "5h", "6h", "7h", "8h", "9h", "10+h"))
  )

build_surface_payload <- \(sub_df) {
  grid <- expand_grid(
    sleep_bin = levels(df_binned$sleep_bin),
    age_band = levels(df_binned$age_band)
  ) |>
    mutate(
      sleep_bin = factor(sleep_bin, levels = levels(df_binned$sleep_bin)),
      age_band = factor(age_band, levels = levels(df_binned$age_band))
    )

  stats <- sub_df |>
    group_by(sleep_bin, age_band) |>
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_grip = round(mean(combined_grip_kg), 1),
      median_grip = round(median(combined_grip_kg), 1),
      iqr_grip = round(IQR(combined_grip_kg), 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  full <- grid |>
    left_join(stats, by = c("sleep_bin", "age_band")) |>
    arrange(sleep_bin, age_band)

  z_mat <- matrix(
    full$mean_grip,
    nrow = length(levels(df_binned$sleep_bin)),
    ncol = length(levels(df_binned$age_band)),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  txt_mat <- matrix(
    paste0(
      "<b>Age Band:</b> ", full$age_band,
      "<br><b>Nightly Sleep:</b> ", full$sleep_bin,
      "<br><b>Mean Combined Grip:</b> ", full$mean_grip, " kg",
      "<br><b>Median (IQR):</b> ", full$median_grip, " kg (", full$iqr_grip, " kg)",
      "<br><b>Participants:</b> n = ", full$n
    ),
    nrow = length(levels(df_binned$sleep_bin)),
    ncol = length(levels(df_binned$age_band)),
    byrow = TRUE
  )

  peaks <- full |>
    filter(!is.na(mean_grip), n >= 10) |>
    group_by(age_band) |>
    slice_max(order_by = mean_grip, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    arrange(age_band)

  list(
    x = levels(df_binned$age_band),
    y = levels(df_binned$sleep_bin),
    z = z_mat,
    hover = txt_mat,
    peak_x = as.character(peaks$age_band),
    peak_y = as.character(peaks$sleep_bin),
    peak_z = peaks$mean_grip
  )
}

surface_data <- list(
  All = build_surface_payload(df_binned),
  Male = build_surface_payload(df_binned |> filter(sex == "Male")),
  Female = build_surface_payload(df_binned |> filter(sex == "Female"))
)

# All 10,987 observations + quantiles for Flagship Lens B
set.seed(2026)
pts_df <- df |>
  mutate(
    sleep_jitter = round(sleep_hours + runif(n(), -0.32, 0.32), 2),
    grip = round(combined_grip_kg, 1)
  )

quantiles_by_hour <- df |>
  group_by(sleep_hours) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    p10 = round(quantile(combined_grip_kg, 0.10), 1),
    p25 = round(quantile(combined_grip_kg, 0.25), 1),
    p50 = round(quantile(combined_grip_kg, 0.50), 1),
    mean_g = round(mean(combined_grip_kg), 1),
    p75 = round(quantile(combined_grip_kg, 0.75), 1),
    p90 = round(quantile(combined_grip_kg, 0.90), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

hero_payload_json <- toJSON(
  list(
    surface = surface_data,
    points = list(
      x = pts_df$sleep_jitter,
      raw_h = pts_df$sleep_hours,
      y = pts_df$grip,
      age = pts_df$age,
      sex = as.character(pts_df$sex),
      cat = as.character(pts_df$sleep_category)
    ),
    quantiles = quantiles_by_hour
  ),
  auto_unbox = TRUE
)

# Compact column encoding for fast browser cross-filtering in Explorer
explorer_records <- df |>
  transmute(
    a = as.integer(age),
    ag = as.character(age_group),
    s = as.character(sex),
    r = as.character(race_ethnicity),
    sh = as.integer(sleep_hours),
    sc = as.character(sleep_category),
    ts = coalesce(as.character(trouble_sleeping), "Unknown"),
    cg = round(combined_grip_kg, 1),
    mg = round(max_hand_grip_kg, 1)
  )

explorer_json <- toJSON(explorer_records, dataframe = "columns", auto_unbox = TRUE)

# Attach local Plotly HTML widget dependencies cleanly without watermarks or CDNs
dep_widget <- plot_ly() |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("function(el) { el.style.display = 'none'; }")
```

      <p class="section-desc">
        Data combine two consecutive waves of the U.S. National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (<strong>2011–2012 Cycle G</strong> and <strong>2013–2014 Cycle H</strong>), merging demographics, self-reported sleep questionnaires (administered to participants aged 16 and older), and Mobile Examination Center (MEC) isometric grip dynamometry.

      <div class="info-grid-3">

            Self-reported usual weekday/workday sleep hours (integer values 2 through 12+, with NHANES codes <code>77</code> Refused and <code>99</code> Don't Know recoded as missing). Categorized into Very Short (&le;5h), Short (6h), Recommended (7–8h), and Long (9+h).

          <p style="font-size: 0.88rem; color: #94a3b8; margin: 0;">
            Objective upper-body isometric muscle strength measured across three trials per hand. Defined by CDC protocol as the sum of the largest reading from each hand (ranging from 8.0 kg to 169.6 kg in our validated sample).

        <div class="mini-panel">
